_comment: Single source of truth for the public origin. The build substitutes __SITE_ORIGIN__ in index.html and the scripts, rewrites sitemap.xml + robots.txt, and stamps functions/_middleware.js and service-worker.js, so moving the site is a change here. Do not add a trailing slash. formerOrigins: addresses the site has had; their pages hand a visitor (and what their browser holds) over to origin, and everything else there redirects to it (functions/_middleware.js).
